description: This file implements a certificate path builder for SSL/TLS certificate validation, including path traversal, issuer selection, trust evaluation, and path verification logic.

classes.name: IssuerEntry
classes.description: Represents a certificate issuer along with its trust level and match order.

classes.name: CertIssuersIter
classes.description: Iterates through potential issuer certificates from sources, supporting synchronous and asynchronous retrieval, sorting, and duplicate prevention.

classes.name: CertIssuerIterPath
classes.description: Tracks the current path of certificates to prevent duplicates and cycles during path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a candidate certificate path with trust and error information.

classes.name: CertPathIter
classes.description: Generates possible certificate paths from a target to a trust anchor, handling depth, iteration limits, and backtracking.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the path building process, managing path iteration, verification, and result collection.

methods.name: FingerPrintParsedCertificate
methods.description: Computes a hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: CertDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string for a certificate, including fingerprint and subject.

methods.name: PathDebugString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a list of certificates for debugging.

methods.name: CalculateKeyIdentifierMatch
methods.description: Determines if the authority key identifier matches the subject key identifier between issuer and target certificates.

methods.name: TrustAndKeyIdentifierMatchToOrder
methods.description: Assigns a priority order to issuer certificates based on trust level and key identifier matching.
